body.title: Adherence and functional-coverage strategies
body.summary: DimensionStrategy for adherence (LLD clauses and PLAN tasks as context atoms, per-clause evidence notes, clause adjudication, no-contract short circuit kept) and functional-coverage (FR atoms, per-FR evidence, FR adjudication).
acceptanceChecks: A clause or FR implemented by symbols in different parts is not reported unrealized; one with no evidence is.
An approved design larger than the budget is split by clause and every clause adjudicated.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'adherence, functional-coverage and coverage adjudicate each requirement on evidence from every part, with or without a test record'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'an approved design larger than the budget is split by clause and every clause adjudicated'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'a symbol and a clause that each fit alone but not together are judged through the joint-fit chain and every call fits'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/review-job-dimensions.test.ts: 'every clause, FR and promised test reaches adjudication, and one no part shows evidence for is reported missing'
